integrity: Transfer-matrix identities are proved over the integers; direct word enumeration and independent state recurrence check every Walsh coefficient through dimension ten and supplementary frequencies through dimension seventeen. Finite computations are not used to infer the all-length theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-length Fourier gap and invertibility for contiguous 001 avoidance only; complete Fourier zero sets, singular ranks, other forbidden factors and cyclic constraints are not classified. Historical priority search is bounded; no external independent validation.
title: A three-phase sharp Walsh stability law for binary words avoiding \(001\)
